functional_requirements.text: SPI shall operate in Master mode when MSTR=1 and Slave mode when MSTR=0.
Switching MSTR between master and slave forces the SPI system into idle state.
Four clock formats are supported via {CPOL, CPHA}; CPOL selects clock idle polarity, CPHA selects sampling edge.
CPHA=0: data sampled on odd-numbered SCK edges (1,3,5,...,15) and shifted on even edges.
CPHA=1: data sampled on even-numbered SCK edges (2,4,6,...,16) and shifted on odd edges.
16 SCK edges complete one 8-bit byte transfer (master and slave shift simultaneously).
Master baud rate = BusClock / ((SPPR+1) * 2^(SPR+1)); divisor range 2 to 2048.
LSB-First Enable: when LSBFE=1, data is transferred LSB-first; when LSBFE=0, MSB-first.
Mode Fault: if SS pin becomes LOW while configured as master with MODFEN=1, MODF flag is set and MSTR is cleared, switching SPI to slave mode.
Data reception is double-buffered: shift register + SPIDR; SPIF set when received byte is in SPIDR.
Master writing to SPIDR starts a transmission after half SCK-cycle delay; if shift register is empty the byte transfers immediately.

error_response_conditions: Mode fault error (MODF) — SS pulled low while master+MODFEN active
Reception overrun — third byte received while SPIF still set (oldest received byte discarded in shift register)

timing_parameters.tL: Minimum leading time before the first SCK edge
timing_parameters.tT: Minimum trailing time after the last SCK edge
timing_parameters.tI: Minimum idling time between transfers (minimum SS high time)

compliance_requirements: Identical CPOL on master and slave for inter-operation.
Identical CPHA on master and slave (or careful handling of CPHA=0 first-bit alignment).
Master must hold SS HIGH or reconfigure as GPO if SSOE is not enabled.
Slave must hold SS LOW for the entire transmission duration.
